info.title: PoYo AI - Convert to WAV API
info.description: Convert generated music tracks to high-quality WAV format

post.description: Convert a generated music track to high-quality WAV format

error.message: WAV record already exists for this audio

BearerAuth.description:
All API endpoints require Bearer Token authentication.

Create an API key: sign in to PoYo, open **Dashboard → API Key** at [poyo.ai/dashboard/api-key](https://poyo.ai/dashboard/api-key), and click to create a key.

Add it to the request header:

```
Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY
```

model.description:
API model identifier.

Must be `convert-to-wav` for this endpoint.

callback_url.description:
Webhook callback URL for result notifications.

The endpoint will receive POST requests with WAV conversion completion status and high-quality file download URL.

task_id.description:
Unique identifier of the music generation task.

Should be a task_id returned from either the Generate Music or Extend Music endpoints.

audio_id.description:
Unique identifier of the specific audio track to convert.

This ID is returned in the callback data after music generation completes.

code.description:
Business status code. `200` means success; any other value means the request failed. Always check this field: some validation errors return HTTP 200 with `code: 400` in the body.

- `200`: Success
- `400`: Invalid request parameters
- `401`: Missing or invalid API key
- `402`: Insufficient credits
- `403`: Permission denied
- `404`: Resource not found
- `408`: Request timeout
- `429`: Rate limit exceeded
- `500`: Internal server error
- `502`: Upstream service error
- `503`: Service unavailable

See [Error Codes](/api-manual/error-codes) for details.

task_id.description: Unique task identifier for status tracking

status.description:
Task status. Always `not_started` right after submission. Use [Query Task Status](/api-manual/task-management/status) or `callback_url` to get later states.

- `not_started`: Queued, waiting to be processed
- `running`: Being generated
- `finished`: Completed; results are in `files` or `output`
- `failed`: Failed; details are in `error_message`

created_time.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the task was created
